explanation._note: Documentation only; ignored by validate_partition.py. Paths are relative to the project root unless absolute.
explanation.partition_path: Path to partition_output.npz produced by build_partition.py.
explanation.validation_data_path: Path to labeled validation .npz from generate_validation_data.py (must contain X and labels).
explanation.target_equilibria: One inline state vector per class, e.g. [[x1, x2], [x1, x2]]. Mutually exclusive with target_data_paths.
explanation.target_data_paths: List of .npz paths, one per class. The final snapshot of the first trajectory (or last row of X) is used as the class anchor. Mutually exclusive with target_equilibria.
explanation.exclude_dropped_predictions: Reserved for future use; dropped and unmapped predictions are already excluded from accuracy totals.
